race.comment: GOLDEN CLOUD (1) returns for the Jolly & Potter camp. Was well found in his debut prep and while he couldn't get off the mark he was far from disgraced with two encouraging efforts in some strong maidens. Looks to have come on nicely during the break, fitted with two hitouts. Is drawn favourably and keeps gun hoop in Toeroek from his most recent trial. Expecting him to shed the maiden tag. PAY DIRT (2) is the obvious main danger after just missing on debut at Murray Bridge where he was doing his best work late. Is sure to have come on from that. Debutant TRAPEZE QUEEN (8) can also play a role. THIS IS THE DAY (3) was flat fresh but has since been freshened and jumped out sharply. Big watch.
